_about: Shown once on each phone after it installs a new Android update (not on a first install). Replace the list with what this update changes, in plain words, each time an Android update is approved and built.
items: Your log now has room to grow: the app keeps its data in its own storage instead of the browser's (which was capped at about 10 MB). Settings shows how much it's using.
Save to…: put a copy of an exported file in any folder or in Drive, from the Saved bar or Exported files.
Back follows your swipe on Android 13 and later: an open panel eases back as you swipe, and leaving the app shows Android's own animation.
Settings switches look and work like Android's, and buttons ripple when pressed.
Long-press the app icon for Continue, with how many pallets the delivery in progress has.
Exported files: a list of the Excel and PDF files the app has saved, to open, share or print again (under Saved deliveries, and in Settings).
After Download (Excel) or saving a PDF, a bar at the bottom has Open and Share, so you needn't go looking for the file.
On a label with several barcodes, the LPN is the one used.
Share text with LPNs in it (for example manifest numbers in an email) to LPN Pallet Log, and choose whether they're manifest numbers or pallets for the log.
The app's text size follows your phone's: Large or Extra large when the phone's text is big. You can still change it in Settings.
Volume-down starts and stops Live scan. Turn it off in Settings if you'd rather use it for the volume.
The screen stays upright on phones while you move about.
Before Android first asks about the camera, the app says what it's for.
Your log stays on this phone only: it's no longer copied into Google's phone backups. Use Download backup in Settings to keep a copy.
No install instructions or install pop-up, since the app is already installed.
This note after each Android update, so you can see what changed.
